title: add vpc control plane terraform: subnets, endpoints, sgs, peering, route53-dns
author: Priya Nair
description: Add Terraform modules and templates to fully provision VPC-based control plane networking for Private deployments. Motivation: private control plane installs require a reproducible, well-documented Terraform module that creates the minimal set of networking primitives customers need (subnets, NAT/route config, interface endpoints, security groups, VPC peering for cross-account control plane access, and Route53 private hosted zone + records). This PR introduces: 1) modules/vpc-control-plane (opinionated defaults for three AZs, public/private subnets, NAT gateway config) 2) modules/vpc-endpoints (S3, ECR, SecretsManager, SSM endpoints as interface/gateway endpoints) 3) modules/sg-control-plane (locked-down SGs for control plane-to-worker and admin access) 4) peering templates and route propagation helpers 5) route53/private-hosted-zone module and example records for control-plane.local + glue for cross-account delegation. Checkout instructions and upgrade notes are included in the module README. Checklist: - [x] Terraform modules implemented with variables and outputs - [x] examples/ directory with a reference plan for a simple control-plane VPC - [x] automated tests (terratest skeleton + unit plan checks) - [x] docs/terraform-control-plane.md with upgrade/rollback guidance - [x] security review and default-deny SGs - [x] Verified plan against staging account (plan applies with no destructive changes) Notes and decisions: keep default scope minimal (no exported public ELBs), default to three AZ private subnets, allow opt-out of NAT gateways for private connectivity using customer-managed egress. This PR is intended as a baseline for the Private installer and will be consumed by the installer helm charts in a follow-up PR.
commits: feat(vpc): add vpc-control-plane module with multi-az subnet layout and NAT options
feat(endpoints): add vpc-endpoints module with interface and gateway endpoints (S3, ECR, SSM, SecretsManager)
feat(sg): add sg-control-plane with least-privilege rules and security group references
chore(docs): add terraform-control-plane.md and example usage in examples/control-plane

Priya Nair (2025-01-18): Added egress restrictions and a terratest that asserts no wide-open egress for control plane SG. Also added a note in docs about customer-managed egress considerations.

Michael Thompson (2025-01-19): Requested that peering routes be conditional (only add routes when peering is created) to support incremental rollout. Suggested a small helper to avoid terraform recreates.
Priya Nair (2025-01-19): Implemented conditional routes and added a lifecycle ignore_changes where appropriate; added explanatory comments in peering.tf.
Eve Chen (2025-01-20): Security review complete, approving changes. Left an advisory about documenting IAM permissions required to run the example plan.
Diego Ramos (2025-01-20): Approving and verified plan on staging account; CI plan shows no destructive actions. Ready to merge.
release_notes: Added Terraform modules to provision VPC control plane networking: vpc-control-plane, vpc-endpoints, sg-control-plane, peering helpers, and Route53 private hosted zone. See docs/terraform-control-plane.md for upgrade and rollback guidance.
